opportunities.title: Ostium Says It Wasn't the Contract — It Was the People. That's Worse.
opportunities.why_now: Ostium just confirmed its $24M exploit was an off-chain breach, not a smart contract bug, shifting blame to ops/key security where most 'audited' protocols never get scrutinized.
opportunities.angle: Post-mortem breakdown: why 'audited, no bug found' is cold comfort when the breach vector is humans/infra, with a checklist of off-chain attack surfaces (signers, CI/CD, admin keys) devs should already assume are compromised.

opportunities.title: H1 2026: Ethereum and Solana Didn't Get Hacked More — They Just Have More to Steal
opportunities.why_now: Blockaid's H1 2026 report crowns ETH and Solana as the biggest hack-loss chains, confirming the thesis that TVL is a bounty, not a badge.
opportunities.angle: Data-led explainer with a chart of losses by chain, arguing liquidity concentration is the actual risk metric — not 'security' marketing from L1s/L2s.

opportunities.title: Bitcoin's Quantum Doomsday Math Just Got a 60-Hour Update — And It's Not in Your Favor
opportunities.why_now: AI reportedly broke a cryptographic algorithm in 60 hours, directly undercutting the assumptions behind Bitcoin's 'we have decades' quantum-resistance roadmap.
opportunities.angle: Skeptical deep-dive on the gap between BIP timelines and AI-accelerated cryptanalysis, framed as 'the migration you're not doing fast enough.'

opportunities.title: $8.5M Gone to a Fake Staking Site — Because 'Flare Network' Still Means Nothing to Most Wallets
opportunities.why_now: Seoul police confirmed an $8.5M XRP drain via a fake Flare staking site, a textbook phishing-clone loss that keeps recurring across every cycle.
opportunities.angle: Anatomy-of-a-scam breakdown (domain, UI clone, wallet approval flow) plus a blunt 'here's the tell you missed' checklist for spotting fake staking portals.

opportunities.title: SummerFi Is Dead. The Exploit Didn't Kill It — the Trust Did
opportunities.why_now: SummerFi is winding down after seven years, explicitly citing an exploit, marking one of the clearer cases of a hack ending a protocol rather than just draining a treasury.
opportunities.angle: Obituary/retrospective on protocol mortality post-hack — why recovery plans and 'made whole' promises rarely save user trust, with lessons for anyone still holding funds in aging DeFi.
